stackDivergence.rationale: Generated schema tables supply the native resource names and value classes. A typed representation carries the source interoperability tree across the browser Worker.

preservedResponsibilities: Consumes generated Word 2010 drawing effect resources and preserves the native nested attributes and ordered, repeated child elements of run outlines and non-solid fills.

The Word 2010 effect roots for glow, shadow, reflection, scene3d and props3d now use the original generated definitions and nested interoperability properties for DOCX run and style persistence through the browser Worker.
omittedResponsibilities: Word drawing effects other than text outlines and fills are pending.

filenameDivergence.rationale: Keeps the generated schema dispatch and validation for native drawing effects beside the original TextEffectsHandler owner.
